_about: RBI Prompt Corrective Action risk thresholds, as published. Each indicator lists its three risk-threshold edges in percent; 'direction' says whether breaching means falling below ('below') or rising to/above ('at_or_above' / 'above'). Check RBI for amendments after the dates below.

bank.circular: RBI/2021-22/118, DOS.CO.PPG.SEC.No.4/11.01.005/2021-22, 2 November 2021 (effective 1 January 2022): PCA Framework for Scheduled Commercial Banks (excluding Small Finance Banks, Payment Banks and Regional Rural Banks)

crar.label: CRAR
crar.basis: Indicator = 9% minimum CRAR + 2.5% capital conservation buffer = 11.5%; RT1 up to 250 bps below, RT2 250-400 bps below, RT3 more than 400 bps below.

cet1.label: CET1 ratio
cet1.basis: Indicator = CET1 pre-specified trigger 6.125% (RBI Basel III AT1 trigger from 31 March 2019) + 2.5% CCB = 8.625%; RT1 up to 162.5 bps below, RT2 162.5-312.5 bps below, RT3 more than 312.5 bps below.

nnpa.label: Net NPA ratio
nnpa.basis: Net NPA to net advances: RT1 >= 6.0%, RT2 >= 9.0%, RT3 >= 12.0%.

leverage.label: Tier-1 leverage ratio
leverage.basis: Regulatory minimum 4% for D-SIBs and 3.5% for other banks (RBI/2018-19/225, DBR.BP.BC.No.49/21.06.201/2018-19, 28 June 2019, effective 1 October 2019, https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=11606); RT1 up to 50 bps below, RT2 50-100 bps below, RT3 more than 100 bps below.

nbfc.circular: RBI/2021-22/139, DoS.CO.PPG.SEC.7/11.01.005/2021-22, 14 December 2021 (effective 1 October 2022): PCA Framework for NBFCs. Applies to deposit-taking NBFCs and middle/upper/top-layer non-deposit-taking NBFCs, excluding NBFCs not accepting public funds, government companies, primary dealers and housing finance companies.

crar.label: CRAR
crar.basis: Regulatory minimum 15%; RT1 up to 300 bps below, RT2 300-600 bps below, RT3 more than 600 bps below.

tier1.label: Tier-1 capital ratio
tier1.basis: Regulatory minimum 10%; RT1 up to 200 bps below, RT2 200-400 bps below, RT3 more than 400 bps below.

lcr_minimum.basis: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio minimum of 100% (RBI LCR guidelines, fully phased in from 1 January 2019; not a PCA indicator).
